tidbit: Did you know… about 9,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is lowering its funding target as investors push for sustainable business models. Reported by The Tech Buzz: the company is adjusting expectations around investment growth.
Reported by NZZ: OpenAI is introducing Cartoonification to block deepfakes during U.S. midterms, with Josh Lawson leading election integrity efforts.
Experts largely follow artificial intelligence suggestions in complex tasks, even when inputs are random. Reported by BornCity: an Anthropic study found experts adopt artificial intelligence recommendations in 86 percent of cases.
Anthropic is updating Claude to block game cloning after Steam faced waves of artificial intelligence-generated game copies. Reported by PC Gamer: the company is steering the model away from letting users replicate games.
Reported by CGTN: Alibaba's Qwen artificial intelligence will integrate into Apple Intelligence for Chinese users starting in December.
Free every hour.
